name: loading-deck-tests
description: End-to-end tests for Loading Deck (Playwright, Chromium). The CDN libraries are served from these local copies.

scripts.setup: npx playwright install chromium && node make_fixtures.js
scripts.test: node e2e.js && node layers_e2e.js && node variant_e2e.js && node standalone_e2e.js && node custom_e2e.js && HASH='#custom-model' node custom_e2e.js && node tour_e2e.js
